uncited: **Inputs:** A trained volumetric grid model (e.g., DVGO) containing density and color features for each voxel; a set of training views.
**Outputs:** A pruned grid model with a subset of voxels retained.
The method operates on a 3D grid where each voxel $v_l$ stores density and color features.
The algorithm computes a scalar importance score $I_l$ for each voxel.
**Ray Shooting and Point Scoring:** Shoot a batch of rays through the images of the training views.
